video_title: Perk & RJ Disagree On What The Spurs Should Do With Dillon Harper

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Dillon Harper's role with the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: If you have a guy on your bench that's making that much money, the last thing that you want is a guy like Dillon Harper looking over his shoulder.
quotes.quote: If you have a guy on your bench that's making that much money, the last thing that you want is a guy like Dillon Harper looking over his shoulder. You want Dillon Harper walking into that practice facility, in that arena, with confidence every day that that's your spot.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins debate Mano Ginobili starting
quotes.excerpt: Should Mano Ginobili have started for the Spurs when he played?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Go back to the Spurs. Should Mano Ginobili have started for the Spurs when he played?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Completely two different situations. Mano Ginobili wasn't drafted with the second pick.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: It doesn't matter. Two things can be true. Mano Ginobili should have been the second pick in the draft. He was that talented as a rookie.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the value of sixth men in crunch time
quotes.excerpt: If you are in there the fourth quarter and crunch time and you are still getting 32 minutes, why should it matter?
quotes.quote: If you are a starter and you play most guys average 30-32 minutes as a starter, right? So if you come off the bench and play 30-32 minutes, what's the difference? If you are in there the fourth quarter and crunch time and you are still getting 32 minutes, why should it matter?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Dillon Harper's impact in the series
quotes.excerpt: The one game that they actually won in that series, Dillon Harper played extended minutes.
quotes.quote: It was one person that the Knicks had no answer for in that series. It was Dillon Harper. Every single time he got two feet in the paint, it was either a bucket or something good came out of it. The one game that they actually won in that series, Dillon Harper played extended minutes, especially in the fourth quarter.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins on Dillon Harper's potential
quotes.excerpt: Do you think Dillon Harper would have been happier if he got drafted to Dallas?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Do you think Dillon Harper would have been happier if he got drafted to Dallas with the number two pick and then won 25 games, right? And then they could start building around him?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I don't know, RJ. But you are saying he is frustrated with his role and I get it, he is an elite player.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Carmelo Anthony's time out of the league
quotes.excerpt: For an extended period of time, Carmelo Anthony for two years was out the league.
quotes.quote: For an extended period of time, Carmelo Anthony for two years was out the league. Not because Carmelo Anthony couldn't help anybody, but a lot of times he wasn't bought into the locker room or on the team, because the young guys that they had plans on putting in front of him, they didn't want him looking over their shoulder.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Rajon Rondo's leadership in Boston
quotes.excerpt: You know what Danny Ainge said I'm going to do? Fuck whoever believe in you, I'm going to go get Eddie House.
quotes.quote: It's just like Rajon Rondo in Boston. You know what Danny Ainge said I'm going to do? Fuck whoever believe in you, I'm going to go get Eddie House, who is a reserve, and I'm going to go get a old school Sam Cassell. That way you don't ever have to worry. I need you with a clear mind every single time you walk in this locker room that we believe in you.
